Game Overview

At its heart, Jumpy! The Legacy of a Chicken is a animal game about escape the slaughterhouse as a daring chicken in Jumpy. The Legacy of a Chicken. Execute flawless wall jumps to dodge deadly electric sparks. Test your reflexes in this fast-paced, nerve-wracking arcade adventure where each leap could mean survival or doom. Timing and precision are your keys to freedom.
